description: Integrates a measured value and forms an interface for cement plant applications, providing two integration values updated at different intervals.

inputs.name: MV_IN
inputs.description: Input for a physical measured value

inputs.name: QC
inputs.description: Transfer of the Quality Code from the upstream measured value FB

inputs.name: REL_INT
inputs.description: Releases the integrate function with a 1 signal

inputs.name: PULS_VAL
inputs.description: Factor for the weighting of the integration time / dimensions conversion

outputs.name: MIH_OK
outputs.description: Indicates if there were no invalid measured values during the past hour
